items.title: 14.4.3 The Volume of the Tetrahedron (Roman Urdu)

blocks.text: Pichle sabaq mein humne dekha ke teen vectors par bane dabbe (parallelepiped) ka volume \([\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\) hai. Aaj usi dabbe ke andar se ek chhoti shakal nikalenge: tetrahedron. Achhi khabar yeh hai ke is ka formula bhi bilkul usi number se nikal aata hai, bas ek fraction lagana hai. Aur woh fraction kahan se aata hai, yeh hum qadam ba qadam dekhenge, taa ke ratna na pare.

blocks.alt: A tetrahedron ABCD. From the vertex A three vectors are drawn: u along AB, v along AC and w along AD. The base triangle ABC is hatched. A dashed vertical line h drops from D to the plane of ABC and meets it at a right angle.
blocks.caption: Figure: tetrahedron ABCD with u = AB, v = AC, w = AD and height h of D above the plane ABC (original drawing after the textbook's figure)

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Tetrahedron kya hai? Yeh aisa thos (solid) hai jis ke chaar (4) chehre hain aur har chehra triangle hai; chaar kone (vertices) aur chhe (6) kinare (edges). Asaan alfaaz mein: aisa pyramid jis ka base triangle ho. Misr ke pyramid ka base square hota hai, magar yahan base triangle hai.
Figure mein kone \(A\) se teen vectors nikalte hain: \(\underline{u} = \underline{AB}\), \(\underline{v} = \underline{AC}\) aur \(\underline{w} = \underline{AD}\). Triangle \(ABC\) ko base maana gaya hai (shaded hissa) aur \(h\) kone \(D\) ki base plane se seedhi unchai hai.

Kitab ke mutabiq:
Volume of the tetrahedron \(ABCD = \frac{1}{3}\) (\(\Delta ABC\) ka area)(\(D\) ki plane \(ABC\) se unchai)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan "above the place ABC" chhapti hai. "Place" (jagah) nahin, sahi lafz "plane" (sateh) hai: \(D\) ki plane \(ABC\) se unchai.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Yahan do purani baatein kaam aa rahi hain:
(1) Kisi bhi pyramid ka volume \(\frac{1}{3}\times\) base ka area \(\times\) unchai hota hai. Yeh aap pichli classon mein parh chuke hain. Is ka mazedaar saboot: ek hi base aur unchai wale prism (seedhe dabbe) ko teen barabar pyramids mein kaata ja sakta hai, is liye pyramid prism ka teesra hissa hai.
(2) Triangle \(ABC\) us parallelogram ka aadha hai jis ki sides \(AB\) aur \(AC\) hain (parallelogram ko diagonal se kaato to do barabar triangles bante hain). Aur us parallelogram ka area \(|\underline{u}\times \underline{v}|\) hai (14.3 se). Is liye \(\Delta ABC\) ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}|\underline{u}\times \underline{v}|\).
Ab in dono ko formula mein rakhte hain:
\(= \frac{1}{6}\) (\(AB\) aur \(AC\) adjacent sides wale parallelogram ka area) \((h)\)

Ab ghaur kijiye: parallelogram ka area \(\times\) unchai \(h\) bilkul parallelepiped ka volume hai (14.4.2 mein yahi parha tha). Is liye:
\(= \frac{1}{6}\) (\(\underline{u}\), \(\underline{v}\), \(\underline{w}\) edges wale parallelepiped ka volume)

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab is line mein \(\frac{1}{3}\) chhapti hai, jo ghalat hai. Pichli line mein \(\frac{1}{6}\) tha aur parallelogram \(\times\) \(h\) hi parallelepiped ka volume hai, is liye yahan bhi \(\frac{1}{6}\) aayega. Kitab ka apna aakhri jawab bhi \(\frac{1}{6}\) hi hai, is liye beech wali line ka \(\frac{1}{3}\) sirf chhapai ki ghalti hai.

blocks.text_alt: Volume equals one sixth of (u cross v) dot w, which is one sixth of the box product u v w

blocks.title: Note
blocks.text: As volume is always positive, so ignore negative sign if \((\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\) is negative.

blocks.title: Teaching note
blocks.text:
Note ka matlab: volume kabhi negative nahin hota. Agar vectors ki tarteeb aisi ho ke \((\underline{u}\times \underline{v})\cdot \underline{w}\) negative aa jaye (14.4.2 mein dekha tha ke \(\theta > 90^{\circ}\) par aisa hota hai), to sirf minus hata dijiye, number wahi rakhiye.
Nateeja yaad rakhne ka tareeqa: "dabba poora, tetrahedron chhatha hissa". Yani isi teen kinaron wale parallelepiped ka bilkul \(\frac{1}{6}\). (\(\frac{1}{2}\) triangle se aaya aur \(\frac{1}{3}\) pyramid se; \(\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\).)
Sawal mein agar chaar kone \(A, B, C, D\) diye hon to:
\[V = \dfrac{1}{6}\left|[\underline{AB}\ \underline{AC}\ \underline{AD}]\right|\]
Dhyan dein: teeno vectors ek hi kone se shuru hone chahiyen. Kaun sa kona lein, is se farq nahin parta; jawab wahi aata hai. Example 26 bilkul yahi kaam karti hai.

blocks.title: Hamari taraf se misaal
blocks.text:
Ek dabbe ka kona kaat kar dekhte hain (yeh hamara sawal hai): kone \(O(0,0,0)\), \(A(1,0,0)\), \(B(0,2,0)\), \(C(0,0,3)\).
\(O\) se vectors: \(\underline{OA} = \underline{i}\), \(\underline{OB} = 2\underline{j}\), \(\underline{OC} = 3\underline{k}\). Yeh teeno aapas mein perpendicular hain, is liye \([\underline{i}\ \ 2\underline{j}\ \ 3\underline{k}] = 1\cdot 2\cdot 3 = 6\).
Formula se: \(V = \frac{1}{6}(6) = 1\).
Ab purane tareeqe se tasdeeq: base \(OAB\) right triangle hai, area \(= \frac{1}{2}(1)(2) = 1\); unchai \(OC = 3\); \(V = \frac{1}{3}(1)(3) = 1\). Dono tareeqon se 1. Formula pe bharosa pakka!

blocks.title: Khud sochiye
blocks.text:
Ek cube (side 1) ke andar kone par aisa tetrahedron banaya jaye jis ke teen kinare cube ke teen kinare hon. Yeh cube ka kitna hissa hoga?
Jawab: \(\frac{1}{6}\). Kyun ke cube khud \([\underline{i}\ \underline{j}\ \underline{k}] = 1\) volume wala parallelepiped hai, aur tetrahedron us ka chhatha hissa.

blocks.title: Yaad rakhne wali baatein
blocks.text:
1. Tetrahedron ka volume \(= \frac{1}{3}\) (base ka area)(unchai).
2. \(\Delta ABC\) ka area \(= \frac{1}{2}|\underline{u}\times \underline{v}|\).
3. Volume \(= \frac{1}{6}[\underline{u}\ \underline{v}\ \underline{w}]\), yani usi kinaron wale parallelepiped ka chhatha hissa.
4. Teeno vectors ek hi kone se: \(\underline{AB}, \underline{AC}, \underline{AD}\).
5. Product negative aaye to minus hata do; volume positive.

blocks.title: Aam ghaltiyan
blocks.text:
1. \(\frac{1}{6}\) ki jagah \(\frac{1}{3}\) (jaise kitab ki ghalat chhapi line mein) ya \(\frac{1}{2}\) laga dena. Yaad: \(\frac{1}{2}\times\frac{1}{3} = \frac{1}{6}\).
2. Mukhtalif konon se shuru hone wale vectors le lena, jaise \(\underline{AB}\), \(\underline{BC}\), \(\underline{CD}\) bina soche. Hamesha ek kone se teen vectors.
3. Volume negative likh dena.
